lantern: Split the owner concept and paint out its label before extraction.
Flood-fill the cream paper from the border with a white matte.
Key the matte with tools/art/key-alpha.ts at 8% fuzz, with no despill.
Trim, fit within 232x232, centre on 256x256, and threshold the alpha matte.
Ship one solid lantern frame; active lighting is rendered by the game.
glows: Generate each decal as bold filled violet/lavender fluorescent watercolor on pure black.
Lift each source with tools/art/black-to-alpha.ts, using brightness as alpha.
Trim, scale within the requested approximate size, and add an 8px border.
Pack variable-size trimmed frames horizontally into glows.png with alpha preserved.
postProcessing.keying: Lantern uses an opaque white-paper matte. Glows use black-to-alpha because they are light painted on black.

review.notes: The lantern is opaque and reads on both cream and dark backgrounds. The shipped glow atlas was reviewed directly over dark and in the Pinecone Pass composite; paw prints read as three filled raccoon handprints, the note as a masked raccoon doodle, and the marker as a filled brushy arrow with a star tail.
